def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    new_grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    
    # Find object color (1 in test input)
    object_color = 1
    
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] == object_color:
                new_grid[r][c] = object_color
                # Mirror across horizontal axis (top-bottom)
                r_mirror = rows - 1 - r
                if r_mirror != r:
                    new_grid[r_mirror][c] = object_color
                # Mirror across vertical axis (left-right)
                c_mirror = cols - 1 - c
                if c_mirror != c:
                    new_grid[r][c_mirror] = object_color
                # Mirror across both diagonals (bottom-right and top-left)
                r_m, c_m = rows - 1 - r, cols - 1 - c
                if r_m != r or c_m != c:
                    new_grid[r_m][c_m] = object_color
    
    return new_grid
